raw_market.question: Virginia Tech vs. California: 2Q O/U 13.5
raw_market.description:
In the second quarter of the college football game between Virginia Tech and California, scheduled for October 10 at 3:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Virginia Tech and California combine to score 14 or more points in the second quarter.

If the combined second quarter total is less than 14, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
